clips.title: The story
paras: Satyrnaar lies in ruin under the Bleakheart satyrs in northeastern Ashenvale. The ancient night elf settlement sits beside the road from Splintertree Post toward Azshara, intact enough to be one of the forest’s easiest satyr strongholds to reach.

You find Satyrnaar northeast of Splintertree Post and southwest of Forest Song, among Ashenvale’s three chief satyr settlements with Xavian and Night Run. Its elven buildings remain more intact than those deep in the wilderness, though tents now stand among the broken stone. The Bleakheart satyrs occupy the camp, making the trade road east toward Azshara dangerous for travelers. They have also allied with the Cult of the Dark Strand, whose soulgem lies among the corrupted stones.
